name: GET /api/fda/search/summaries - search public 510(k) summaries
description: Hybrid search across indexed public 510(k) summaries: keyword (Postgres full text) and semantic (bge-m3) rankings fused with reciprocal rank fusion. q is required (2-500 characters); optional productCode (three letters), kNumber and limit (1-50, default 10). Each hit carries ref ('K262392#8'), K-number, page, text, score, keyword and semantic ranks, applicant, device name, product code, decision date and the FDA PDF URL. Edge cases: when the embedding model is unreachable the answer is still 200 with mode 'keyword' and a note; no match returns an empty hits list; q shorter than 2 characters is 400. Covers: a 510(k) summary PDF is fetched once, cached, parsed and embedded (the embedded passages are searchable). Needs the fda-data service with indexed summaries (DQY tracked) and its embedding model.

errorCases.message: q must be at least 2 characters
errorCases.when: q missing or shorter than 2 characters, malformed productCode/kNumber, or limit out of range

errorCases.message: FDA data is unavailable right now. Try again shortly.
errorCases.when: the fda-data service is down or rejects the app key
errorCases.notReproducibleReason: Needs the fda-data service stopped during the run; same proxy path as GET /api/fda/510k/:kNumber, verified by hand.

testCases.name: Member searches the summaries of product code DQY
